build_datahandler: build a DataHandler to prepare training eval and test data batches for a PyText model
create_batchiterator: create a BatchIterator to yield input target and context tuples from TorchText batched data
load_vocab: load a vocabulary from a file with optional size limit and lowercase token normalization
init_metadata: initialize feature and target metadata including vocabularies from train eval and test datasets
read_from_file: read tab-separated data from a CSV file and yield rows as dictionaries keyed by column names
